data.subject: Several things (long, sorry)
data.body: Hello, I've been a Pro subscriber for about eight months now and overall I like the product, but a few things have piled up and I wanted to get them all down in one message rather than sending five separate ones, so apologies in advance for the length. First, and this is the one that actually matters to me: about two weeks ago the app started randomly losing the last few edits in a project when I switch between the timeline view and the mixer view. It doesn't happen every time, maybe one in five switches, but when it does happen I lose anywhere from thirty seconds to several minutes of work. I'm on the Mac desktop app, version 4.12.1, macOS 15.6, and I've already tried reinstalling. There's nothing in the activity log that shows an error, the edits are just gone. I've started saving obsessively but that shouldn't be necessary. Second, the price increase that was announced in the newsletter last month feels steep to me, going from $29.99 to $39.99 is a 33% jump and I didn't see a corresponding jump in what I get for it. I'm not cancelling, at least not yet, but I'd like to understand what the roadmap actually is, because from the outside it looks like most of the new features are going to the Team plan. Third, and this is more of a wish than a complaint: the stems export is great but it would be much more useful if I could choose the sample rate and bit depth instead of always getting 44.1/16, since I usually work at 48/24 and have to convert. Fourth, a tiny one, the keyboard shortcut for 'duplicate clip' conflicts with a system shortcut on macOS and I can't find a way to remap it. And finally, thank you for the improved noise reduction, it's noticeably better than it was in the spring. I know this is a lot, so if you want to split it into separate tickets that's fine, but please make sure the first point about losing edits actually reaches someone on the engineering side, because if that isn't fixed the rest doesn't matter much to me. Best regards, Georg
3 stars. Results are honestly great when it works, but the free tier is way too limited (3 generations a day??) and the app crashed twice while I was previewing. Would pay if it were more stable.
